player_prompt.intro:
Uri kucheza game ya Minesweeper.
Chinangwa che game ndicho kubuditsa maselo yose asina mimeya.
Kuita zviito, taura tu nhamba dze safu na safu wauri kubuditsa, wakapanga kwa njira iyi:
- `[row col]`: Buditsa cela kune safu na safu wakapanga.
Somhi:
- `[3 2]` kubuditsa cela kune Safu 3, Safu 2.
- `[5 6]` kubuditsa cela kune Safu 5, Safu 6.
Pakutanga, uchabuditsa nzvimbo yakapoterera cela uchague, kudzingira kutanga kwako kubayiwa.
Mhando yebhodhi iripo pazasi. Maselo asanabuditswa anowanikwa na doti ('.'), nhamba dzabuditswa dzononyanya mimeya iri pedyo.
Tsvaga kutenge kuisa maselo akabuditswa.
Mhando yebhodhi iripo pazasi:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hauna kupindura nemakona anobvumirwa ari muzvibatanidzi zvakapetwa.

outcome.turn_limit: Muganhu wokutendeuka wasvika. Wakabudirira kuzarura {percent}% yematare akachengeteka.
